newsitem.title: UK: Stakis set for 220 mln stg cashcall - paper.
newsitem.headline: Stakis set for 220 mln stg cashcall - paper.

text.p: Glasgow-based Stakis Plc is set to announce a 220 million sterling rights issue in anticipation of clinching the deal to buy the Metropole hotel portfolio from Lonrho Plc, the Financial Times said on Thursday.
It said Stakis, a hotels and casinos group, could launch its cashcall as early as Thursday, adding that the price paid for the Metropole hotels could be 320 million stg.

Analysts told Reuters on Wednesday that Stakis and Saudi billionaire Prince al-Waleed bin Talal are the most likely buyers of the Metropole chain. The current owner, British conglomerate Lonrho, shelved plans to float the chain after receiving interest from possible buyers.
Stakis is the front-runner to buy after another pulled out.
Hotel group Millennium & Copthorne withdrew from the race earlier this month, leaving Stakis as the hot favourite.
